No online booking or quote path confirmed.

operations_signals.signal: The firm publishes only a Gmail address and a phone number, with narrow 9-4 weekday hours - inference: after-hours enquiries (common in criminal/TRO matters) have no channel.
14 public reviews after 30+ years and an unclaimed profile - inference: no systematic review collection or listing management.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace/repair the site so it loads for crawlers and AI agents: remove the blanket bot challenge, publish crawlable practice-area pages for New Brunswick, and add one clear 24/7 intake path.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (hours, practice areas, photos) and run systematic review requests to grow past 14 reviews.
top_opportunities.evidence: Birdeye profile is unclaimed with 14 reviews for a practice operating since 1992.

scores.reasons: Gap looks large (blocked site, no online intake, thin listings) and a solo firm is quick to serve, but contingency-driven revenue limits budget and my evidence is thin because the site itself could not be viewed.

agent_readiness.notes: LocalBusiness/AccountingService JSON-LD present and consistent with the listed address and phone; services written as crawlable text with dedicated pages; responsive with tel: links. But hours are absent from page and schema, there is no pricing despite a Pricing page, and the contact form sits behind reCAPTCHA with an account-creation consent - an agent can submit a lead, not book.

operations_signals.signal: Firm publicly promises replies within 12 hours - inference: response time is a managed, staffed process and a natural target for an intake/follow-up agent.
Sells part-time CFO, payroll and bookkeeping retainers to practices and SaaS firms - high-value recurring clients with document-heavy onboarding.
Two brand identities (Easy Prep listings/reviews vs Veritas website) with no cross-reference on-site - inference: duplicate listings are splitting local visibility and reviews.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate the brand online: fix or redirect the expired easyprepcpa.com certificate, merge/de-duplicate the Easy Prep and Veritas Google listings, and state clearly which office serves New Brunswick clients.
top_opportunities.evidence: Old domain shows ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID; the site lists only Somerville while directories still publish the New Brunswick address and 40 Easy Prep reviews.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online scheduling with real slots and remove the account-creation consent and reCAPTCHA from the primary contact path, keeping one short labelled form.
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page has a 10-field form with reCAPTCHA and consent to 'the creation of an account'; no calendar anywhere.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish actual pricing tiers (the Pricing page is empty) and add hours/service area to schema so prospects and their assistants can qualify before booking.
top_opportunities.evidence: vpacpa.com/pricing renders only header/footer; JSON-LD has address and phone but no hours, price range or service list.

scores.reasons: The live site is modern and well built, so the gaps cluster around the stale Easy Prep identity (broken certificate, split listings, missing New Brunswick presence); a growing CPA firm selling CFO retainers can pay and the fixes are small.

businesses.name: Lacerda Insurance Agency
businesses.what_they_do: Independent insurance agency writing personal auto, commercial auto, homeowners, renters, general liability and workers' compensation, representing carriers such as Progressive, Foremost, Liberty Mutual, Home-Choice, Bristol West, Hiscox, Am-Guard and Travelers. Also runs an in-person walk-in office.
businesses.customers: Individual drivers and homeowners plus small business owners (contractors, employers needing workers' comp and general liability), concentrated in New Brunswick's Latino/Portuguese-speaking community.

size_signals.signal: Site states 'over 15 years of industry experience' and refers to its agents as a team
Single Livingston Avenue storefront with adjacent parking and walk-in service; hours Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-2
Represents a dozen-plus carriers across personal and commercial lines - inference: a small independent agency (roughly 2-5 staff) with multiple appointments

listing.platform: Third-party directory snapshot of the Google listing (localitybiz) - Google not viewed directly

website_review.primary_cta: 'Get A quote!!' linking to a single auto-quote form
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: One auto-insurance quote form (21 fields including date of birth, licence number and VIN); every other line is phone, email or walk-in
website_review.trust_signals: 15+ years, named carrier partners, a five-star customer testimonial on the homepage, photos, FAQ covering parking, documents and turnaround
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer credit 'Wonder - A WordPress Block theme by YITH'; URLs contain an odd install path (/website_c1d19621/); no copyright year shown; homepage has no meta description
website_review.search_basics: Title is the agency name twice ('LACERDA INSURANCE - LACERDA INSURANCE AGENCY') with no service or town, no meta description, and only WebPage JSON-LD - no InsuranceAgency/LocalBusiness schema, hours or services markup; coverage types share one page
top_issues: No click-to-call: the phone number never appears as a tel: link, so a phone visitor ready to buy cannot tap to call.

The only online quote path is an auto-only 21-field form asking for licence number, date of birth and VIN; home, general liability and workers' comp prospects are told to call, email or visit, and the FAQ admits home/commercial quotes take 2-4 business days.
No LocalBusiness/InsuranceAgency structured data and no town or service in the title/description, so search and AI assistants cannot confidently answer 'who insures X in New Brunswick' from the site.

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt could not be read (the server returned HTTP 406 to a non-browser client), so crawler rules are unverified. Hours, address, services and carrier partners are readable text and the FAQ answers common questions - good for answerability. But schema is WebPage only and there is no booking, only a quote form.

operations_signals.signal: FAQ tells customers to email documents and says a home or commercial quote 'can take up to 2-4 business days' while underwriters respond - inference: slow manual quote turnaround a follow-up agent could shorten by chasing documents.
FAQs about parking, EV charging and what to bring for a quote show a walk-in-heavy, in-person workflow where staff handle each transaction manually.
Only 15 public reviews after 15+ years - inference: no systematic review requests.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build quote intake for every line (auto, home, renters, GL, workers' comp) with short stepped forms, licence/VIN upload, instant acknowledgement and follow-up until underwriter pricing arrives.
top_opportunities.evidence: Only an auto-only 21-field form exists; the FAQ says other quotes require calling, emailing or visiting, with 2-4 business days for home/commercial.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add click-to-call plus WhatsApp/messaging intake and an assistant that answers coverage questions, collects driver/vehicle/business details and books a quote appointment.
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links anywhere; audience is bilingual and walk-in/phone-first, with no chat or booking on the site.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add InsuranceAgency JSON-LD (address, hours, services, carriers, area served) and rewrite titles/descriptions around 'auto & commercial insurance New Brunswick NJ'.
top_opportunities.evidence: Only WebPage schema; title repeats the agency name and the homepage has no meta description.

scores.reasons: Missing click-to-call, single-line quote intake and no local schema on a highly rated agency is a real gap and cheap to fix; an independent agency's income is commission-based, so budget is moderate.

businesses.name: Barrood Agency
businesses.what_they_do: Full-service independent insurance and bonding agency operating since 1940 (80+ years), writing personal lines (home, auto, boat, motorcycle), business coverage (commercial auto, general liability, builders risk, cyber, D&O, umbrella, workers' comp), bonds and life/health, with access to excess and surplus carriers. Also runs real estate and travel divisions.
businesses.customers: Families and individuals for personal lines, plus hundreds of small and mid-sized businesses, contractors and professionals needing commercial coverage and surety bonds across Somerset and Middlesex counties.

size_signals.signal: 'For over 80 years… serving our client's Insurance, Real Estate and Travel needs since 1940!'; site celebrates the 80-year milestone
Two offices (46 Bayard St Suite 212, New Brunswick and Somerset NJ), described as 'a division of Enterprise Risk Associates', with a dedicated surety bond department and team page
Sister business Barrood Real Estate plus a travel division - inference: a mid-sized family agency group, likely 10+ staff

listing.platform: Liberty Mutual independent-agent directory (Somerset office listing) - Google listing for the New Brunswick office not confirmed

website_review.primary_cta: 'START QUOTES' / 'Start A Quote' plus a click-to-call phone button in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Multi-step online quote request covering 16 coverage types (auto, home, condo, renters, BOP, work comp, builders risk, cyber etc.), plus client-services login and referrals pages
website_review.trust_signals: 80 years in business, named client testimonials, both offices and hours in the footer, reviews page, SMS consent and accessibility statements, carrier relationships and E&S access
website_review.out_of_date_signs: No material staleness found (2025 image uploads, current pages, SMS consent page); however the schema still carries an old, wrong address
website_review.search_basics: Unique titles per page ('Start Your Quotes in Seconds | Barrood Agency'), meta description naming Somerset NJ, a page per business insurance line, InsuranceAgency + Organization + WebSite JSON-LD; hero headline leads with 'SOMERSET, NJ' rather than New Brunswick
top_issues: The InsuranceAgency JSON-LD holds a wrong address: '6417 Roosevelt Ave', addressLocality 'Somerset and Middlesex County', addressRegion 'NY', postalCode '11204' (a Brooklyn, NY address) - contradicting the real New Brunswick and Somerset offices and feeding false answers to search and AI assistants.
Phone links are malformed (href="tel:(732)%20247-8664", with parentheses and a space) so tap-to-dial fails on many phones despite the visible phone button.

Structured data has no openingHours or areaServed, and the site positions the firm as 'Insurance Agency Somerset, NJ' with no dedicated New Brunswick location page - inference: the New Brunswick office is under-promoted.

agent_readiness.notes: Crawlable, well-titled site with service pages and a real multi-step quote request (no CAPTCHA, 31 labels, 16 coverage types). InsuranceAgency schema exists but its address is wrong (NY 11204) and there are no hours or areaServed; phone hrefs are malformed. An agent can submit a detailed quote request but cannot get an instant quote or book a time.

operations_signals.signal: Quote intake is a long multi-step form (45 inputs across steps) that a staff member must then work by hand with carriers - inference: each new-business quote consumes agent time, the clearest place for AI-assisted prefill.
Firm publishes a 'CLIENT SERVICES' portal plus referrals and reviews pages, showing an organised service operation rather than ad-hoc paper.
Testimonials emphasise responsiveness ('always get back to you… with no delays') - response speed is the firm's stated differentiator.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the knowledge layer: correct the InsuranceAgency schema address, add openingHours and areaServed for both offices, repair tel: hrefs and add a New Brunswick location page.
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD address reads 6417 Roosevelt Ave, region NY, postal 11204; phone hrefs contain parentheses/spaces; no hours in schema and no New Brunswick page.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-intake assistant that pre-fills the multi-step form from a document (registration, declarations page, business info), chases missing items and drafts the carrier submission for the agent.
top_opportunities.evidence: Quote flow needs 45 field values across 16 coverage types and staff must then shop carriers by hand.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Renewal and service automation: scheduled renewal reviews, certificate-of-insurance requests and review requests so the service team stops re-keying routine work.
top_opportunities.evidence: Agency sells commercial lines and bonds where COI requests and renewals are constant, and already has a client-services portal to integrate with.

scores.reasons: Site and quote flow are genuinely good, so the gap is concentrated in wrong schema, malformed phone links and a missing New Brunswick presence; an 80-year agency with commercial lines, a bond department and real estate has clear budget.

caveats: Ratings and review counts come from third-party snapshot pages (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe, localitybiz, Liberty Mutual agent directory), not from Google itself; Google Maps was not opened for any business, so 'claimed vs unclaimed' refers to the aggregator profile unless stated otherwise.

Phone-width behaviour was verified with 390px emulation and screenshots for eight businesses; Reid Weinman Law could not be rendered at all (Cloudflare challenge) and Easy Prep/Veritas was checked by viewport width only (392px, no horizontal overflow).
Where a site could not be fully inspected, website_review fields are marked unverified/false rather than guessed, and the limitation is stated in top_issues and data_gaps.

Several businesses in this batch sit on the same block of Livingston Avenue in New Brunswick and share a bilingual/immigrant small-business clientele; recommendations were kept business-specific, but the same fixes (click-to-call, schema, short intake with a calendar) recur because the same gaps recur.
data_gaps: Reid Weinman Law: www.reidweinmanlaw.com returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to both plain fetch (403) and an automated real Chrome session, including /robots.txt; site content, phone layout, CTAs, forms and JSON-LD could not be verified. Practice areas, address and 'since 1992' came from search-result summaries of the firm's own pages, not from a direct read.

M&Y International Financial Services: no Google/aggregator listing was confirmed, so rating and review count are 'unknown'. A Yahoo Local page returned in search mentioned a 4.5/22-review profile for a nearby M&Y listing but the address on that page could not be tied to the New Brunswick office, so it was not used.
BD Tax: the site's claim of '200 employees in 14 countries' could not be verified and looks like template/network copy; staffing remains unknown.
Samuel Fisher CPA: robots.txt was not inspected separately (the site's redirect-everything behaviour was the dominant finding); hours are known only from the Birdeye profile, not the firm's site.

Easy Prep Tax & Accounting: the batch address (317 George St, Suite 320, New Brunswick) does not appear on the current site, which lists only 94 Grove Street, Somerville; whether a New Brunswick office still exists is unconfirmed (inference: consolidated at the rebrand to Veritas Planning Advisors). The www.easyprepcpa.com TLS certificate error was also hit by the browser, not inspected in detail.
Lacerda Insurance: robots.txt returned HTTP 406 to a non-browser client, so crawler permissions are unverified; the review count/rating is a directory snapshot.
Barrood Agency: the Google Business Profile for the New Brunswick office could not be confirmed; the 4.3/22 rating is from the Liberty Mutual agent directory for the Somerset office.
Villanueva's Professional Services: whether the New Brunswick appointment form submits successfully (and whether it has spam protection) was not tested, since forms are never submitted.
